title: Mission: Collect 'Em All
description: Mission: Collect 'Em All — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect Whisker Figurines from the Whiskers in Algernon and return to the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Mission: Get 'Em All Painted

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect Whisker Figurines from the Whiskers in Algernon and return to the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Offer:

As much as I want to drag this out and make it extremely amusing for myself, I will just cut to the chase. The Townston Commander likes to play with dolls. Dolls of Oroks, Mutants, Fades, Whiskers, all of them, and now the new batch of Whisker figurines is on the market so he wants them. They have fully articulating joints and some even come with Kung Roo Action Grip, but that is about as cool as they get. Anyway, he says that he uses them for his tactical battle map and it helps him to strategize, but seriously, he loves to play with dolls. L-O-V-E-S the dolls.

So, unless you have used your incredible power of deduction without giving yourself a stroke, I will go ahead and tell you about this 'important mission' from the most powerful man in Townston: Collect Whisker Dolls. Now, I would not call them dolls to the Commander's face. He doesn't like that. Call them figurines.

Collect a 'figurine' for each different type of poisonous Whisker in Algernon--you can tell them apart from other Whiskers by their green highlights. Here is a list. When you have them all rounded up, return to me, the Townston Lieutenant, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Wow, you really did collect 'em all. Extreme-Happy-Fun-Smile-Star! What is the word I am looking for? Oh, yeah, I got it! Whoopitty-dooo! Hmm, I feel that I should be making a hand motion while saying that word, but I just cannot bring myself to care at the moment. As much as you want me to tell you that your job here is done, it is not. Please hold while I think about this next part and glare at you dismissively.

Objectives:

  • Sissirat Clan Broodling Figurine ×1
  • Sissirat Clan Blademaster Figurine ×1
  • Sissirat Clan Venomspitter Figurine ×1
  • Sissirat Figurine ×1

Level range: 10–20
